correctness.rationale: Exact two-site reduction verified against Pires–Rosales eqs. (2),(4). For a<=1, artanh(z)-az is strictly increasing and forces zero. For a>1, uniqueness of r and b follows from monotone artanh(r)/r and strict concavity of H_a. Explicit substitution produces thirteen distinct solutions. Six polarized states have a negative antisymmetric Jacobian eigenvalue and a remaining block of negative trace and positive determinant for all a>1; positivity follows from two proved hyperbolic inequalities. Finite checker confirms 568 diagnostic assertions, not the infinite quantifier.
